name: NoiseAurora
description: Atmospheric aurora backdrop combining slow-drifting spectral ribbons with an inline procedural SVG fractal-noise film grain layer and zero external image assets.
a11yNotes: Uses an inline SVG feTurbulence noise filter marked aria-hidden='true' with zero network requests and pauses ribbon drift under prefers-reduced-motion.

propsApi.name: grainOpacity
propsApi.description: Opacity of the procedural SVG fractal noise overlay.

propsApi.name: auroraSpeed
propsApi.description: Duration in seconds of the aurora ribbon drift.

propsApi.name: ribbonOpacity
propsApi.description: Luminance opacity of the aurora curtains.
